title: Northloop Payments Ledger Card: Booking an Instant Payout Fee
content:
Every instant payout sent from a Northloop Payments account to an eligible debit card bears a fee, and that fee is booked on the payments ledger as an entry of its own, separate from the instant payout.

## Situation of use and capability

`post_instant_payout_fee_64da22a6` books the fee of an instant payout on a seller's Northloop Payments account. One call books one instant payout fee entry on the payments ledger that names the instant payout it is charged for, and lowers the account's total balance by the fee; the seller then sees the fee next to that instant payout in their payments history. The fee is taken exactly as given; nothing else on the account changes.

## How it is invoked

This is an agent-side tool: the support agent unlocks `post_instant_payout_fee_64da22a6` and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `payout_account_id` | the payments account reference number of the seller's Northloop Payments account, as returned by the payments account lookup | identifier |
| `disbursement_ref` | the payout reference number of the instant payout the fee is charged for, as shown on that instant payout in the payments ledger lookup | identifier |
| `amount` | the instant payout fee in USD | a positive number with 2 decimal places (cents), rounded to the cent before it is passed; booked exactly as given |

## Return

A text rendering of a dictionary describing the fee booked:

- `status` — the literal `fee_posted` when the fee entry was booked;
- `payout_event_id` — reference of the new payments ledger entry;
- `disbursement_ref` — payout reference of the instant payout charged for;
- `amount` — the fee in USD with 2 decimal places;
- `balance` — the account's total balance in USD after the fee, 2 decimal places;
- `event_date` — the date the fee was charged, YYYY-MM-DD.

*Hypothetical illustration.* A call naming an instant payout's reference with `amount` 12.34 returns `status` `fee_posted`, the same `disbursement_ref`, and a balance 12.34 USD lower than before.
